title: C¹ image covered by an Hⁿ-null set and countably many finite-measure C¹ submanifolds
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} be of class C¹. Then there are N₀ ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with Hⁿ(N₀) = 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) and sets N_q ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} (q ∈ ℕ), each satisfying IsC1Submanifold n and Hⁿ(N_q) < ∞, such that G(ℝⁿ) ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃_q N_q.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Amb n ℓ), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (N : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ q, IsC1Submanifold n (N q) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (N q) < ∞) ∧ range G ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ q, N q
